quests.name: Mom's Errand
objectives: Visit Professor Oak at his lab

quests.name: Oak's Parcel
objectives: Pick up the parcel at Viridian PokéMart
Return the parcel to Professor Oak

completionDialogue.speaker: Professor Oak
pages:
Thank you so much for
delivering this parcel!

I've been waiting weeks for these
research supplies. You're a lifesaver!

As promised — here's your reward.
10 Poké Balls and 200 Poké Dollars!

Keep up the great work, trainer.
There's a whole world out there
waiting for you!

quests.name: Stock Up
objectives: Buy an item from Viridian City PokéMart

completionDialogue.speaker: Store Clerk
pages:
Smart move stocking up early!
You never know what's out there.

Here — take this Potion on
the house. Come back anytime!

quests.name: Rest Up
objectives: Heal your Pokémon at Viridian City Pokémon Center

completionDialogue.speaker: Nurse Joy
pages:
We hope to see you again!
Your Pokémon are always welcome here.

Here's a little something for
making use of our services!

quests.name: Road to Route 22
objectives: Defeat a wild Pokémon on Route 22
Defeat another wild Pokémon on Route 22
Defeat one more wild Pokémon on Route 22

completionDialogue.speaker: Youngster
pages:
Whoa, you cleared out Route 22!
You're tougher than you look!

Here — take these Poké Balls!
You're gonna need 'em!

quests.name: Nidoran Hunter
objectives: Catch a Nidoran ♂ or Nidoran ♀ on Route 22

completionDialogue.speaker: Bug Catcher
pages:
You caught a Nidoran?!
Those are super rare around here!

That Pokémon's Poison Point
ability is no joke — take this
Antidote, you'll need it!

quests.name: Old Man's Apology
objectives: Speak to the Old Man near Route 2

completionDialogue.speaker: Old Man
pages:
Hey, kid! Sorry about blocking
the road earlier — my coffee
hadn't kicked in yet!

Here, take this Super Potion.
It's way better than the
regular stuff. Good luck out there!
